strength.title: Strength of the pile
strength.enable: Check the strength of the pile
strength.hintTimber: Compression parallel to the grain under N_Ed + F_nk;d (EN 1995-1-1). k_mod and γ_M: defaults for permanently wet timber and permanent load. Buckling is not checked.
strength.hintSteel: Cross-section class and axial force of the tube under N_Ed + F_nk;d (EN 1993-1-1). Buckling is not checked: the program has no free or weakly supported length.
strength.hintConcrete: Axial force of the concrete section under N_Ed + F_nk;d (EN 1992-1-1), without reinforcement. Buckling is not checked.
strength.notesTitle: Assumptions and what is not checked

status.outside: outside the scope of this check

rows.timberAxial: Timber: compression parallel to the grain
rows.timberToe: Timber: smallest cross-section at the toe

notes.load: N_Ed;max = N_Ed + F_nk;d, applied from the pile head to the bottom of the negative skin friction zone. Below that the axial force decreases through positive shaft friction; that part is not checked.
notes.steelNoSection: Not checked: the steel section (core tube, wall thickness) is not part of the input for this pile system.
notes.class4: Cross-section class 4: local buckling governs. This is outside the scope of this check (EN 1993-1-6); the resistance has not been calculated.
notes.class4Short: Outside the scope of this check (cross-section class 4).
notes.steel: Steel: only the tube with the entered wall thickness and f_y for t ≤ 40 mm; a concrete fill is not taken into account. Not checked: buckling (cl. 6.3; the module has no free or weakly supported length), corrosion (enter the remaining wall thickness), welds and couplings, and the driving stresses.
notes.timber: Timber: strength class {{cls}} with f_c,0,k = {{fc}} MPa (EN 338); k_mod and γ_M are input, defaults for permanently wet timber and permanent load. Not checked: buckling (cl. 6.3.2), the joint with an extension, decay of the timber and the driving stresses.
notes.timberToe: For information: upper bound with the full N_Ed;max on the toe cross-section. The positive shaft friction above the toe has not been deducted; the actual force at the toe is smaller.
notes.concrete: Concrete: N_Rd = A_c · f_cd of the shaft cross-section, without reinforcement (it is not part of the input). Not checked: the minimum eccentricity (cl. 6.1 (4)), buckling, the reinforcement and the driving stresses.
notes.concreteInSitu: Cast-in-place pile: the reduced design diameter (cl. 2.3.4.2) and the increase of γ_c (cl. 2.4.2.5) for piles without permanent casing have not been applied; convert the resistance for this yourself.

openTube.plug: With plug: steel ring + η × inner section
openTube.plugFactorMissing: Enter η (0 to 1) — without η nothing is calculated.
openTube.hintPlug: With a plug the steel ring counts plus η times the inner section; η = 1 is the full section. The standard gives no value for η: substantiate it, for example with the friction inside the tube (NEN 9997-1 art. 7.6.2.3(d); above 500 mm also art. 7.6.2.1(13)).
openTube.hintNoPlug: Without a plug only the steel ring counts and the friction inside the tube is ignored; that is a lower bound of NEN 9997-1 art. 7.6.2.3(d).
